summary: Annovis Bio filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of 7,895,000 shares and warrants to purchase 7,105,500 shares at $1.90 per unit, with gross proceeds of ~$15M. The offering is a routine capital raise under an effective shelf registration, not a special situation. Proceeds fund clinical development and working capital. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The offering closed the next day. This is an ordinary underwritten offering with no transformative corporate event. Watch for dilution but no risk-arb angle.
